review_note: AI source review covers every own-body section and block of IEEE 1800-2023 clauses 1–41 and annexes A–Q. Rows retain source occurrences, conditional obligations and initial observation cases; they are not a deduplicated whole-standard denominator. Open interpretations are explicitly retained. Unmapped means no reviewed test link, not absence of an existing test. No independent human approval is implied.

denominator_review.scope_note: All source has been reviewed and requirements extracted. Interpretation conflicts, semantic duplicates and the relationship between requirements and initial concrete observation cases must be reconciled before approving a unique whole-standard behavioral denominator.
